theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_schauder_interior_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → α < 1 → ∀ lam M R : ℝ, 0 < lam → 0 < R → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x₀ : Rn n) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : Rn n → Rn ℓ), (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ a x P P) → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q| ≤ M * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ R, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q - a y P Q| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ R, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Φ x P - Φ y P| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖w x‖ ≤ M) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w (ball x₀ R) → (∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖fderiv ℝ w x - fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball x₀ R → ∫ x in ball x₀ R, a x (fderiv ℝ w x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in ball x₀ R, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ (R / 2), ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ (R / 2), ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ (R / 2), ‖fderiv ℝ w x - fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
